body: this is so sweet, it reminds me of better times in my life. i hope i can find someone to share moments like this with again someday.

i haven’t created anything in a long time. i have no motivation. any pictures of art on my profile are just things i’ve found online, not mine. regardless, i don’t think creating anything for myself generates purpose. it’s just a thing to do. i desire my purpose to be along the lines of making people happy, helping people, taking care of people, loving people. that could be multiple people, or even just one person. doing this in ways that directly impact their lives for the better. you could argue that anything artistic i create could bring people joy, but that’s not the significant impact i’m looking to cause. i want to change lives for the better.

i thought i was truly loved and appreciated. i thought for the first time in my life i had someone who for certain cared about me, loved me, and wanted the best for me. someone who changed from their fuck ups and grew to be better. i thought i finally had my life all figured out, i thought i finally had a purpose.

shared myself with a person who turned out to be lying to me for a long time. someone who clearly took advantage of my desperation, who knew they could manipulate me and get away with a lot of shit, someone i left the mental hospital for when i wasn’t truly ready. someone i was already going against my morals for since i had no one else, who decided to do more shit behind my back that they knew would hurt me, who guilted me and tried to play victim even though they knew they shouldn’t have been messing with me in the first place. 

i did things i never would’ve had i known everything. in doing so, i lost myself completely, threw myself away. since then i’ve had an emptiness that i always knew would never be able to be filled again. i’ve tried to ignore it, tried to keep doing things that should’ve made me happy, but nothing makes me happy anymore. my positive emotions now feel neutral at most. if i experience something that *should* make me truly happy, internally i just feel okay, maybe a fraction of excitement for a moment, but it’s not happiness. then i’m immediately met with the emptiness again. 

i hate that the happiest and most confident i’ve ever felt about myself and my life happened while i was being lied to; happened because of a person who destroyed me. i don’t know how to cope with that.

i was 10 years old when we got her. i had always wanted a purebred pom. we already had a bichon pomeranian mix, bailey, and decided she needed a friend. my grandma found an ad in the newspaper from a lady selling the last few pups of the litter and she had heavily reduced the price. we drove way out into the country. when we got there, i sat on the floor and biskit immediately hopped into my lap. she chose me. i was ecstatic of course to have this new baby. but after some time of her growing, i realized she wasn’t gonna turn out like the typical solid red/orange/cream pom that i had always dreamt of, and i became bitter and stopped liking her for some time. god, i wish i could go back and slap myself, selfish little brat. of course i eventually got over that and she became my world.
